extracted.name: Remoulade Sauce
extracted.description: This homemade remoulade sauce recipe is SO easy to make! Creamy and tangy, it's a perfect quick dipping sauce for French fries, crispy cauliflower, and more. Find additional serving suggestions in the post above.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, mustard, hot sauce, paprika, garlic, scallion, lemon juice, onion powder, and cayenne.
See the blog post above for remoulade serving suggestions.
